candidates.claim: OT-facing access port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/3 is assigned to VLAN 30 (CORP) instead of VLAN 10, although the registry requires OT-facing ports to be access ports in VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Set GigabitEthernet1/0/3 back to access VLAN 10, or document a registry-approved exception for this port.

candidates.claim: sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/3 switchport access VLAN changed from the approved baseline value 10 to 30, a deviation that must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change with the approved baseline: revert the port to VLAN 10, or update the baseline through change approval.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN, bound inbound on GigabitEthernet0/0/0, permits any-source tcp/443 to 203.0.113.2 (the fw-01 outside address) while fw-01 has its HTTP/ASDM server enabled, although the registry allows device management (HTTPS/ASDM) only from MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the tcp/443 permit to 203.0.113.2 from EDGE_IN on rtr-01 so that HTTPS/ASDM management is reachable only from MGMT, and confirm whether the fw-01 HTTP server needs to remain enabled.
